note: Titles and stages transcribed from Status of the Series. Tasks are original game exercises, not claims about specific holdings, unreleased documents, or official compiler assignments. Kennedy and Johnson stops provide background only. Clinton XIII individual page still says Planned; the requested status overview lists Being Researched, which governs this snapshot.

assignments.title: 1917–1972, Volume III, Public Diplomacy, World War II
assignments.task: Map wartime information-policy decisions and intended foreign audiences.
assignments.comparison: Separate the policy directive from the broadcast or leaflet used to carry it out.

assignments.title: 1917–1972, Volume IV, Public Diplomacy, 1945–1952
assignments.task: Prepare a source survey for the transition from wartime information work to postwar public diplomacy.
assignments.comparison: Keep a planning inventory distinct from a selected manuscript.

assignments.title: 1956–1960, The Intelligence Community
assignments.task: Trace the division between intelligence assessment, coordination, and presidential authorization.
assignments.comparison: An assessment is evidence of analysis, not proof that a policy was approved.

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Survey Kennedy-era refugee-policy precedents as background to the later 1975–1984 assignment.
assignments.comparison: Mark pre-1975 material as background; do not insert it as an in-period document.
assignments.selection: dated background lead, outside volume scope

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Survey Johnson-era immigration-policy precedents for the later refugee and immigration assignment.
assignments.comparison: Distinguish earlier statutory context from later implementation decisions.
assignments.selection: background context with an explicit date limit

assignments.title: 1969–1976, Volume E–10, Documents on American Republics, 1969–1972
assignments.task: Recheck the Uruguay source trail while that chapter remains in clearance.
assignments.comparison: Other chapters are published; do not treat Uruguay as already released.
assignments.selection: Uruguay source trail and unresolved clearance

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XLII, Refugees and Immigration, 1975–1984
assignments.task: Investigate the 1975 refugee response within the volume’s cross-administration scope.
assignments.comparison: Follow decisions across evacuation, admission, and resettlement; retain agency disagreements.

assignments.title: 1977–1980, Volume X, Iran: Revolution, January 1977–November 1979
assignments.task: Verify the source trail and chronology for policy toward revolutionary Iran.
assignments.comparison: Stop at November 1979; distinguish unresolved clearance from research availability.
assignments.selection: dated source note and clearance flag

assignments.title: 1981–1988, Volume XXIII, Iran-Contra Affair, 1985–1988
assignments.task: Trace the relationship between Iran initiatives, Contra support, and authorization decisions in 1985–1988.
assignments.comparison: Compare contemporaneous records with later recollections; do not silently merge conflicting accounts.

assignments.title: 1989–1992, Volume XX, North Africa; Sub-Saharan Africa
assignments.task: Build a decision chronology for North Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa during 1989–1992.
assignments.comparison: Keep regional and country-specific decisions connected without substituting Southern Africa or Somalia volumes.
assignments.selection: in-scope country and regional decision records

assignments.title: 1993–2000, Volume XIII, Global Issues: Transnational Commons
assignments.task: Trace how cross-border environmental and shared-resource issues reached foreign-policy decision makers.
assignments.comparison: Keep scientific background distinct from diplomatic choices, negotiations, and implementation.
assignments.selection: scientific context and diplomatic decision trail

assignments.title: 2001–2008, Volume VII, Global War on Terror: “Road to 9/11” and Immediate Aftermath, 2001–2003
assignments.task: Distinguish pre-attack warning records from post-attack policy decisions within 2001–2003.
assignments.comparison: Preserve what officials knew at the time; label later hindsight and do not infer declassification.
